physical.physical_description: Woman's longyi made of silk with a floating weft weave and unsewn. The ground of cloth consists of warp bands of pale green, pale pink and blue in regular sequence with alternate weft threads of pale green, pale pink and pale blue in regular sequence. The design, created by pink and green paired floating weft threads of acheik (horizontal wave patterns), run up the warp direction of the cloth.

It consists of a tube made up of a warp length of cloth sewn by hand across a weft seam, so that the warp runs horizontally around the body of the wearer. Dark red ground with weft yellow acheik (horizontal wave) patterns in 'joe gee jay' style ('jay' means hook or line). The pattern of these bands is of several parallel wavy lines, broken by a diagonal bar with a single blossom within the waves;  of three wavy bands; and broken interwoven lines, in a sequence.

physical.physical_description:
Modern zinme (Chiangmai) design. Yellow, white, green, blue and lilac honeycomb weft patterns on a plain pink warp ground.
There is a vertically striped area, consisting of pin stripes and closely patterned linear designs which forms the inside pleat of the longyi.
The warp ends of the rectangle are drawn together and seamed to form a tube. The spare material is lapped over to the left and tucked in at the waist forming a pleat.
